lines.junior: DEXTER'S SAFE
lines.master: DEXTER'S SAFE

lines.rookie: I found them first! Finders keepers!
lines.junior: I found them first! Finders keepers!
lines.master: I discovered them first! Finders keepers!

lines.rookie: The Lark is for a child of the city. Not for you.
lines.junior: The Lark is meant for a child of the city. Not for you.
lines.master: The Lark was meant for a child of the city. Never for you.

lines.rookie: And you cut a page from a treasure of this library.
lines.junior: And you cut a page out of one of this library's treasures.
lines.master: And you sliced a page from one of this library's treasures.

lines.rookie: I'm sorry I kept quiet so long.
lines.junior: I'm sorry I stayed quiet for so long.
lines.master: Forgive me for keeping silent so long.

lines.rookie: The police lead Dexter out. The Lark still sleeps in its castle.
lines.junior: The police take Dexter away. The Lark is still sleeping in its castle.
lines.master: The police escort Dexter out. The Lark still slumbers in its castle.
